value.answer: Call 911 now or go to the ER right away. Fever with a rash that does not fade when pressed can be a serious infection, and it cannot be sorted out at home. Do not wait for more symptoms or for the rash to change.
value.triage: Call 911 or go to the ER now - do not wait. Go even if the rash fades or your child seems a bit better. Cold hands and feet, drowsiness, floppiness, fast breathing or a stiff neck make it even more urgent. 811 is not a reason to delay.
